ios.desc:
FullWallet is a personal finance app for people who want a clear answer to one question: how much can I actually spend?

Every month starts with your income. FullWallet subtracts your fixed costs, your spending and what you have put aside, then shows what is genuinely left — updated the moment you add anything.

TRACK IT IN SECONDS
• Add income, expenses and savings in a couple of taps
• Name and icon your own categories, and edit them whenever you like
• See income against spending at a glance, and which categories take the most
• Set a monthly limit on a category and hear about it before you run out

FIXED COSTS THAT BEHAVE
Rent, subscriptions, insurance — enter them once and they count every month on their own. They are never duplicated as expenses and never inflate your spending charts, so what you compare month to month actually means something.

CARD PAYMENTS THAT LOG THEMSELVES
Switch on automatic transactions and every card tap you make in a shop files itself — amount, merchant and a matching category — without you opening the app. A shop it does not recognise lands in Other; change it once and it stays changed.

ADD BY VOICE
Say “spent 45 euros on groceries” and FullWallet fills in the amount, the currency, the category and the name. It waits for you to finish talking instead of cutting you off mid-sentence.

STRAIGHT FROM YOUR HOME SCREEN
The widget shows what is available to spend and takes you straight into adding income, an expense, a saving, or a voice entry. Whichever button you tap, the app opens already doing it.

AI MONEY COACH
Once a month, get a plain-language read on where your money went: the one pattern worth acting on, and a few concrete things to try.

BUILT FOR SAVING
Track what you have set aside by month, by year, or across all time, and watch the total climb.

WORKS THE WAY YOU DO
• 73 currencies, with a currency per transaction and automatic conversion
• 46 languages, with voice entry in 35 of them
• Light and dark themes
• Export everything to CSV, and import it back when you change phone

YOUR NUMBERS STAY YOURS
Your transactions live on your iPhone. There is no account to create and no sign-up, and individual transactions are never uploaded — running an AI analysis sends your monthly totals by category, nothing more.

FULLWALLET PREMIUM
Premium unlocks automatic card transactions, voice entry, and the monthly AI Money Coach. Everything else stays open to everyone: tracking, budgets, fixed costs, savings, the widget, and CSV
